Supreme Court Orders Centre to Ground Airlines for Airfare Violations

The Supreme Court has directed the Centre to ground airlines that are not complying with airfare norms. The court issued a stern warning, stating that airlines should be grounded if they continue to violate these regulations. This directive aims to enforce adherence to established airfare rules within the aviation sector.
